settings.tagline: Creative Ideas. Strategic Design. Meaningful Experiences.
settings.bio: Durman Nasar Studio is a multidisciplinary creative practice combining graphic design, kinetic motion, digital marketing, photography, videography, and spatial 3D experiences. We craft resonant visual identities and campaigns for forward-thinking enterprises, property developments, luxury hospitality, and cultural brands.

projects.title: AURA — Luxury Editorial Identity & Packaging
projects.description: A bespoke brand identity and tactile packaging suite for an artisanal fragrance house, blending classical proportion with contemporary restraint.
projects.challenge: The fragrance house required an aesthetic language that resisted transient trends, speaking to discerning luxury buyers in Tokyo, Paris, and Jakarta without relying on generic gold accents.
projects.approach: We developed a custom neoclassical serif logotype, paired with blind-debossed raw cotton paper stocks and a strict monochrome palette with a single terracotta vermilion accent.
projects.strategy: Focused on haptic micro-textures and unboxing rhythm to elevate perceived product value by over 180% across regional retail flagship counters.
projects.seoTitle: AURA Luxury Editorial Brand Identity – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Complete brand identity and packaging design case study by Durman Nasar Studio for luxury perfume house Aura.

projects.title: SYNAPSE — 3D Immersive Exhibition Pavilion
projects.description: A 240-square-meter architectural exhibition pavilion designed for the Asia-Pacific Smart Cities Biennial, featuring fluid curved acoustic envelopes and interactive product pods.
projects.challenge: Create a show-stopping physical presence that balances high foot-traffic flow, private VIP consultation chambers, and an interactive digital product showcase within strict expo height limits.
projects.approach: Engineered an organic double-curved architectural shell utilizing brushed titanium composite and warm travertine plinths, accented by subtle ambient circadian LED illumination.
projects.strategy: Choreographed a seamless visitor journey starting from a dramatic open portal into intimate touchpoint alcoves, boosting dwell time by 3.4x compared to neighboring exhibits.
projects.seoTitle: Synapse 3D Exhibition Pavilion Design – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Award-winning 3D exhibition booth architecture and spatial experience designed by Durman Nasar Studio for Kinetix.

projects.title: TERRA — Hospitality Doc & Cinematography
projects.description: An evocative cinematic mini-documentary capturing the sensory soul of a cliffside tropical modernist sanctuary in Uluwatu, Bali.
projects.challenge: Elevate the resort past predictable travel influencer tropes into an emotionally gripping architectural visual essay that appeals to ultra-high-net-worth travellers.
projects.approach: Filmed on anamorphic primes during twilight and dawn golden hours. Natural ambient soundscapes captured on location were woven with an original minimalist cello score.
projects.strategy: Distributed across targeted YouTube pre-roll, luxury private aviation lounges, and bespoke landing pages, producing a record-breaking surge in direct international bookings.
projects.seoTitle: Terra Luxury Hospitality Cinematography – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Cinematic brand film and aerial videography for ultra-luxury hospitality estate by Durman Nasar Studio.

projects.title: KRONOS — Kinetic Motion & Broadcast Ident
projects.description: High-energy rhythmic kinetic typography system and broadcast identity suite for an innovative Southeast Asian financial streaming channel.
projects.challenge: Transform dense financial market reports into captivating, high-velocity motion graphics that retain viewers through fast commercial breaks.
projects.approach: Engineered a variable font motion system in Cinema 4D and After Effects with physics-based acceleration curves and bold industrial framing.
projects.strategy: Standardized reusable motion design kits across 24 daily news segments, cutting production assembly turnaround by 65%.
projects.seoTitle: Kronos Kinetic Motion & Broadcast Graphics – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Kinetic typography and broadcast identity graphics designed by Durman Nasar Studio for Vanguard Media Network.

projects.title: NOCTURNE — Social Media Visual Strategy & Content Engine
projects.description: An editorial social media ecosystem that turned an independent specialty coffee atelier into a viral cultural touchpoint across Instagram and TikTok.
projects.challenge: Stand out in an oversaturated beverage market without resorting to cheap clickbait or generic aesthetic latte art reels.
projects.approach: Designed a high-contrast editorial grid alternating deep origin sourcing stories, ASMR bean roasting micro-cuts, and barista craft masterclasses.
projects.strategy: Built an algorithmic-first short-form video release rhythm generating over 2.4 million organic monthly impressions in under 90 days.
projects.seoTitle: Nocturne Social Media Visual Strategy – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Editorial social media content engine and viral growth strategy by Durman Nasar Studio.

projects.title: NEXUS — Performance Acquisition & Omnichannel Growth
projects.description: A high-converting digital acquisition framework combining precision programmatic ads, high-converting interactive landing pages, and lead retargeting.
projects.challenge: Lower customer acquisition cost (CAC) for a B2B wealth management platform in an increasingly competitive fintech climate.
projects.approach: Executed 120+ targeted creative iterations testing message framing against corporate treasurers, mid-market founders, and high-net-worth investors.
projects.strategy: Re-architected the client onboarding funnel with instant portfolio simulators, slashing drop-off rates and doubling qualified lead volume.
projects.seoTitle: Nexus Digital Marketing & Performance Campaign – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Omnichannel digital marketing and conversion rate optimization case study by Durman Nasar Studio.

projects.title: SOLSTICE — Commercial Post-Production & Color Grading
projects.description: A pulse-pounding, seamless commercial edit for a flagship luxury electric vehicle launch, aired across international digital billboards and streaming services.
projects.challenge: Stitch together 60 hours of raw multi-camera footage into an uninterrupted, adrenaline-fueled 60-second hero commercial and seven vertical cutdowns.
projects.approach: Cut on precise rhythmic downbeats using micro-speed ramping and bespoke film grain textures, finished with a custom cinematic teal-and-copper color profile.
projects.strategy: Mastered in Dolby 5.1 and vertical 9:16 mobile formats simultaneously, achieving immediate cross-platform viral distribution on launch day.
projects.seoTitle: Solstice Commercial Video Editing – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: High-end commercial video editing, sound design, and color grading by Durman Nasar Studio for Solstice EV.

projects.title: MONOLITH — Architectural & Editorial Photography
projects.description: A comprehensive editorial photographic series documenting a brutalist concrete cultural centre in Central Java, exploring natural light cast through massive geometric voids.
projects.challenge: Capture the monumental scale and subtle concrete aggregate textures without optical distortion across varying daylight conditions.
projects.approach: Utilized specialized tilt-shift lenses and calculated sun-angle tracking, exposing during dawn overcast and blue hour twilight for maximum tonal gradation.
projects.strategy: Published as a featured editorial monograph in leading global architecture journals including Dezeen and ArchDaily.
projects.seoTitle: Monolith Architectural Photography – Durman Nasar Studio
projects.metaDescription: Award-winning architectural and commercial photography series by Durman Nasar Studio.

services.title: Graphic Design
services.tagline: Brand Identity Systems, Visual Systems & Editorial Publications
services.description: We build enduring brand ecosystems rooted in typographic proportion, thoughtful tactile materials, and razor-sharp digital guidelines. From initial mark conception to global packaging suites, every design choice solves a strategic brand problem.

services.title: Motion Graphics
services.tagline: Kinetic Typography, 3D Brand Motion & Broadcast Idents
services.description: We bring static brands to life with purposeful choreography, physics-informed animation, and rhythmic typography. Our motion work captures attention in fractions of a second on digital billboards, social platforms, and broadcast television.

services.title: Social Media
services.tagline: Editorial Content Engines, Community Architecture & Viral Formats
services.description: We transform brand feeds from forgettable promotional spam into compelling cultural publications. Combining aesthetic integrity with algorithmic precision, we build active communities that advocate and convert.

services.title: Digital Marketing
services.tagline: Omnichannel Performance, Funnel Optimization & Paid Acquisition
services.description: Creative and data working in tandem. We build digital acquisition systems that turn cold attention into loyal customers through rigorous creative testing, high-converting landing pages, and meticulous attribution.

services.title: Video Editing
services.tagline: High-Retention Commercial Cuts, Color Grading & Sound Design
services.description: Post-production with surgical precision. We craft pacing that grips the audience, blending rhythmic cuts, professional DaVinci Resolve color grading, immersive sound design, and clean visual effects.

services.title: Photography
services.tagline: Architectural, Editorial, Hospitality & High-End Product Photography
services.description: We capture light, material, and human emotion with documentary precision and artistic intent. Every shot is crafted to tell a story of craftsmanship, prestige, and authenticity.

services.title: Videography
services.description: From concept scriptwriting to camera roll and aerial drone cinematography, we produce cinematic films that elevate brand prestige and captivate modern audiences worldwide.
tools: RED / ARRI / Sony FX6 Cinema Cameras

services.title: 3D Exhibition Booth
services.tagline: Immersive Spatial Environments, Expo Pavilions & Retail Pop-ups
services.description: We translate brand identity into physical spatial experiences. From 3D conceptual modeling and realistic lighting simulations to construction drawings and material curation, we engineer booths that dominate the expo floor.
